name: com.incode.welcome_sdk.ui.id_info.IdInfoActivity
description: After text is read from an identity document, this screen lets the user review and, when allowed, correct details such as name, birth date, document number, and address. The MetaMap identity verification SDK opens this screen when the configured flow reaches this step.
disableEffect: Disabling it prevents users from reviewing or correcting document details required for verification.
